- TOTAL revenue reached £88.5k in TW versus £60.8k in LW, a WoW change of +45.56%.
- TOTAL units came in at 51,065 in TW across 2,019 orders, with units up 105.8% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 in TW with revenue of £6,009.01, a 6.8% share of TOTAL TW revenue.
- ROTATING SILVER ANGELS T-LIGHT HLDR delivered £5,866.33 in TW, 6.6% share, and the largest WoW gain at +£5,115.86.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS posted £4,046.96 in TW (4.6% share) and gained £2,661.37 WoW, while BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME added £2,043.78 WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER took £2,754.49 in TW (3.1% share) and CHILLI LIGHTS took £2,473.89 (2.8% share), with the top five products at 23.9% of TOTAL TW revenue.
- PARTY BUNTING fell £2,522.92 WoW, JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT fell £1,396.83 WoW and HEART OF WICKER LARGE fell £904.77 WoW.
- BROCADE RING PURSE rose 3,063.7% WoW among top-quartile revenue products.
